name: water-cycling
title: Water Color Cycling: river currents and beach surf move, as in the DOS version
why: The DOS build rotates 8 palette entries (CYCLE.DAT: 0x78..0x7F) from the timer interrupt, and
only a few pixels use them: a line down each river (PHYS0.SS frames 1..31), the surf inside the
beach pieces (150..153) and sparkles on the sea lane -- rivers flow, surf moves, the open sea
stays still.
The Windows water sheet, picture 0xcc, was drawn the same way. init_water_sprites installs it
at palette 40 with 102 colours instead of 96; its extra raw 96..101 -- game entries 136..141 --
sit only on the river centres of its sprites 0..31, the surf of 150..153 and the fish, and it
cuts exactly those cells over sheet 201's plain rivers and beach (its table at SEG20:0x4526 is
g_art_base[28]). The Game Options item "Water Color Cycling" and its saved bit
(GAMEFLAG_NO_WATER_CYCLING, 0x100 of SEG20:0x7784) survived too. Nothing ever read the bit or
rotated the entries.
This patch rotates entries 136..141 up by one, as DOS does, on every cursor blink of
GameBrains_DoHuman's idle phase (25 ticks, 0.42 s), through the game's own dead palette_rotate;
bumps the palette's seed so GRPort_ColorSync re-sends the WinG colour table; and re-blits the
map view. Off in Game Options, off here.
No byte changes length. The code is written over the dead palette_cross_fade (1068:0d94);
the three relocation records whose sites fell inside those bytes are moved onto the new
code's three far operands; the two records behind DoHuman's calls to
MiniWin_HighlightActiveUnit are pointed at the hook, which runs the tick and then jumps
to MiniWin_HighlightActiveUnit with the caller's stack untouched.
known_limits: Water moves only while the game waits for input on the map (the cursor blink, 0.42 s a step --
DOS steps every ~0.29 s from the timer), not during unit moves or AI turns. On a real
256-colour palette device the colours reach the screen through the WinG colour table by WinG's
translated blit; that mode is untested.
test: Start or load a game and leave the map idle: the centre line of every river and the surf
along coasts glint and move, about twice a second; open sea, lakes, marsh and the fog-of-war
edge do not move. Game Options > Water Color Cycling off: it stops. Open and close a colony:
status: seen in play 2026-09-26 (Wine 11 + otvdm on macOS): river currents and beach surf move, the rest of the water does not

sites.note: the hook and its tick, over the first 123 bytes of the dead palette_cross_fade, up to its first fixup the patch keeps (0e0f)
was palette_cross_fade's call at 0ddd; now the hook's closing jmp far MiniWin_HighlightActiveUnit
was an additive SEGMENT fixup at 0dbf; now non-additive, SEG20's selector for mov ax,SEG20
was palette_cross_fade's call at 0df3; now the tick's call far map_blit_tiles
GameBrains_DoHuman's first call to MiniWin_HighlightActiveUnit -> water_hook
GameBrains_DoHuman's second call to MiniWin_HighlightActiveUnit -> water_hook
